verdict.rationale: Foreloop offers a documented CLI with stable `--json` output, meaningful exit codes, and token-based auth explicitly designed to be run by 'anything that can run one, including coding agents' (foreloop-docs-6, foreloop-docs-7, foreloop-docs-8, foreloop-docs-17), which supports agentic/programmatic building. There is also an official npm package (@foreloop/feedback) but it is scoped narrowly to the feedback widget rather than a general-purpose API SDK (foreloop-docs-19, foreloop-docs-18). Missing for 10: no evidence of broader multi-language official SDKs (Python, etc.) for core Foreloop functionality beyond the CLI and the narrow feedback widget package, and no independent developer corroboration of building against these interfaces.
